service.name: FreeVideoGenerator
service.descriptionEn: Generate AI images and videos, quote credit costs, manage media and track batch jobs with OAuth.
service.descriptionZh: 通过 OAuth 连接已有账号，发现图片与视频模型、查询积分与报价、上传参考素材、创建单个或批量生成任务并获取结果。

authentication.default: OAuth authorization code with PKCE S256
authentication.additionalReferenceScope: Reference-based quotes and generation also require media:read.
authentication.developerKeys: Optional developer key with MCP permissions through Authorization: Bearer or X-Api-Key; no credential is included in this packet.

reviewWorkflows.name: Read-only discovery and quote
steps: Connect with OAuth and the intended scopes.
Call get_capabilities, list_models, get_generation_schema and get_account.
Quote an exact supported generation draft with quote_generation; no paid generation is submitted.

reviewWorkflows.name: Paid generation within an authorized budget
steps: Quote the exact input and check balance/budget.
Use a stable fresh UUID, expectedCredits from the quote, and the exact quoted generation.
Create one generation or a batch of 1–12 independent children with distinct child UUIDs.
Poll at least ten seconds per active job and preserve UUIDs on uncertain retries.
Read actual completion, charge/refund state, task link and expiring result URL.

reviewWorkflows.name: Reference upload
steps: Create an upload capability, transfer a supported file as multipart field file or use the browser page signed into the same account.
Resolve get_upload to an owned fileId before quoting reference-based work.

limitsAndData.privateMedia: Owned media stays account-scoped; capabilities depend on the live grant/key.
limitsAndData.quota: Creator-assist suggestions use the existing daily quota.
limitsAndData.generationBilling: Creation uses existing account credits; quote first. Tasks charge/refund independently, including in a partially failed batch.
limitsAndData.availableActions: Image/video creation, configured Quick Apps, shot suggestions, task tracking, owned media upload/import/download.
